notes.title: 📢 Cursed Halls Update: The Horror Expands!
notes.content:
📢 Cursed Halls Update: The Horror Expands!

The terror in Cursed Halls grows with one of the biggest updates yet. New mechanics, maps, enemies, and an even more challenging experience await. Are you ready to face the darkness?
🗺️ New Maps: More cursed locations to explore

    Haunted Hospital: Dark corridors and abandoned rooms echo with the screams of the lost.
        👹 Doctor Anathemus: A twisted demon armed with cruel surgical tools, always searching for his next victim.
    Forsaken Prison: A fortress of despair, haunted by the cries of the condemned.
        👹 The Executioner: A relentless hunter wielding a massive weapon.
        👹 The Warden's Daughter: A ghostly figure seeking revenge for the secrets buried in this prison.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/f234d860e8182a26acb6eeff1de8000992dc9bb5.png[/img]

🏫 Enhanced Abandoned School

The school demon has become smarter, deadlier, and even more terrifying. Survive... if you dare.
✨ New Mechanics: Every step matters

    Magic crystals: Reveal hidden traps and locate demons through walls.
    Bear traps: Immobilize you and slow your movement, leaving you vulnerable.
    Sound traps: Noise detectors that alert demons to your location.
    Fall damage: Think twice before jumping, or you’ll pay the price.
    Expanded inventory: Carry up to 8 items, but choose wisely—every slot counts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/01b274f5bb15863ae00eb871b735feda6141fed0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/4b08baedf9b15202151ef368e60ab0e834af209b.png[/img]

🔧 Improvements and Fixes

    Revamped AI to make every encounter more tense and terrifying.
    Numerous bug fixes for a smoother, more polished experience.

🎮 Try the Demo!

Haven’t played Cursed Halls yet? A free demo will soon be available, letting you experience the first level of this stealth horror adventure.

📥 Update now and face the fear.

notes.title: Massive Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Survivors,

The nightmare of Cursed Halls is about to grow darker and more intense! In just a few days, we’re releasing a major update that introduces two brand-new maps, three unique enemies, and exciting new features to enhance your experience. Are you ready to face the ultimate challenge?

[h2][b]Map 1: The Abandoned Hospital[/b][/h2]

Step into the decaying, haunted halls of an abandoned hospital, where survival becomes a test of wit and strategy. This map introduces a new enemy, a relentless demonic entity that will stalk you through dimly lit corridors as you try to escape through two exits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/8adecaa392d609b634f4bd0b9bac28ff9101b628.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/17f40693f7fc71a037e0f601a79e9623cce66131.png[/img]

Your path won’t be easy:

[list]
[*]Deadly bear traps will hinder your progress, forcing you to tread carefully.
[*]To aid your survival, the Trap Detector Crystal is introduced. Activate it to briefly reveal the hidden traps blocking your way. But use it wisely—the crystal’s power is limited.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/59d3ea71510ca3e08e625af51493cdef6080f809.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/8b588ff7e0dcbc6d80d7ce67ffe8c2fcf3a7115e.png[/img]

Survive this harrowing ordeal, and you’ll unlock the next challenge: [b]The Prison.[/b]

[h2]Map 2: The Prison[/h2]

The prison is a sprawling, labyrinthine nightmare that will test your survival skills to their limit. With its twisting corridors and oppressive atmosphere, it’s designed to keep you on edge.

But the real terror lies in its enemies: Two brand-new demonic foes will hunt you simultaneously.

[list]
[*][b]The Executioner[/b]: A slow but relentless stalker that will never stop chasing you, no matter where you go.
[*][b]The Warden's Daughter[/b]: An unpredictable predator that strikes with terrifying precision when you least expect it.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/4d61490dacd401b6de450822d5756b698904ece4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/34c49a1667c051f17d4f5c911c93156b11073caf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/69d58a2234f9ab56b5fed7a94d8433b3eebb5e98.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/368f5d72091f1b68158717ee662b23d06f716e8e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/204e1465e3ca78b4daa87652c3c3fdd4c5bd9dce.png[/img]


To help you navigate this deadly maze,[b] both magical crystals[/b] are available in this map:

[list]
[*] The [b]Trap Detector Crystal[/b] we all know and love.
[*] The [b]Enemy Tracker Crysta[/b]l: Allows you to see enemies, even through walls, for a limited time.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/b1901dbaf11883347f31b50ae060fbd3deae7d6a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/0aa2ac4de2e7713d3e89b2f6965833c7e651f22c.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Enhancements and Bug Fixes[/h2]

In addition to the new maps and enemies, this update brings a variety of improvements:

[list]
[*]Enhanced[b] gameplay mechanics[/b] for smoother, more immersive action.
[*]Upgraded [b]enemy AI[/b], making your foes smarter and more dangerous than ever.
[*]Numerous[b] bug fixes[/b] to ensure a more polished and seamless experience.
[/list]

[h2][h1]Release Date[/h1][/h2]

This exciting update will be available in just a few days! Prepare to face new challenges, master new tools, and confront terrifying new enemies.

Will you survive the hospital? Can you outsmart the dual threats of the prison?

The stakes have never been higher, and the horrors have never been more real. Mark your calendars, survivors—the nightmare is only beginning.

Stay strong, stay sharp, and good luck.

notes.title: 📢 Exciting Cursed Halls Update Coming Soon! 🕯️🚪
notes.content:
Since the launch of Cursed Halls, we’ve been working tirelessly to improve your experience. Thanks to your invaluable feedback, here are some of the key issues we’ve resolved:

    🛠️ The demon no longer gets stuck, and its AI has been refined to better detect and chase players.

    👀 Fixed a bug where the demon occasionally failed to see and attack the player.

    🩹 Several smaller bugs affecting gameplay have also been fixed.

Alongside these fixes, we’ve introduced significant improvements:

    🗝️ The loot system has been revamped, making it easier to find that elusive final object in the dark classrooms.
    🔦 The flashlight is now marked on the map from the start, so you’ll never have to stumble around in the dark.

But that’s not all! With the core mechanics now stable, it’s time to look ahead to the future of Cursed Halls.

We’re thrilled to announce that a new map is on the way:

🏥 The Abandoned Hospital
This challenging new level will unlock after completing any of the school exits and will feature:

    ⚠️ Additional traps to keep you on your toes.
    🕵️ New mechanics to enhance exploration and survival.

And there’s more—after the hospital, another new map is in development, though we can’t reveal any details just yet.

🎨 Here’s a sneak peek at early screenshots of the hospital map!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/890b4cdb2fd0a002ecb657e510e1fb3607cc03a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772462/343d6c0af827eb508c8de4a52c76837f2efa21d6.png[/img]


This update will be ready in the coming weeks, and we can’t wait for you to try it out.

Thank you for your continued support, and we’ll see you in the haunted halls of Cursed Halls!

notes.title: Cursed Halls Beta 0.8.7
notes.content:
I’ve noticed that many of you have had difficulties while playing. The game seemed too difficult for you, and I’m afraid it might be frustrating.

The idea was to provide a challenge, but not at the cost of the game not being fun. Therefore, I’ve made some changes to make life a bit easier for those trapped in the school, giving them a better chance to survive encounters with the demon.

To address this, I’ve changed the system for hiding in lockers, closets, and under tables, so the demon can no longer pull you out if you hide while being too close. To avoid making the game too easy, I’ve increased the demon's speed to balance things out and keep the tension alive.

Added:

    Steam Leaderboards.
    Some windows have been boarded up to prevent the demon from seeing through them.
    The demon no longer pulls you out of hiding even if it’s very close.
    Some hiding tables have been removed.
    Increased the demon’s speed.
    The player loses more stamina when running.
    The exits now indicate how many items are still needed.
    Added more tables in the cafeteria to block the demon’s view, allowing for escape.
    New demon sounds.

Bug Fixes:

    The demon now opens doors correctly.
    The demon moves around doors more efficiently.
    Some interactable objects had no sound.
    The demon can no longer kick the gym balls and score goals.
    The demon no longer gets stuck in the locker room.
    Looting sounds continued playing even after stopping the looting process.
